115.  (1) The High Court shall, on an application made by
the  Director-General  or  any  officer  authorized  by  the
Commission  within  a  reasonable  period  grant  a  non
conviction based forfeiture order in respect of any property
within  the  jurisdiction  of  such  court  where  the  court  is
satisfied prima facie on the balance of probabilities that such
property  is  or  such  property  represents  property  obtained
through  any  of  the  offences  committed  under  this  Act  or
property  intended  to  be  used  in  committing    any  of  the
offences under this Act.
